mentions.name: The Ten Dollar Adventure
mentions.description: A children's interactive book in Choose Your Own Adventure style about creative problem solving and entrepreneurship. Readers join protagonist Daphne on a week-long adventure launching her own mini-businesses, help her make decisions, solve challenges, and learn about money and problem-solving along the way. The book is currently open to beta readers via a sign-up page.
